title: atriplex hastata subsp. triangularis
intro: Atriplex hastata subsp. triangularis, commonly known as a plant species of the Atriplex genus, is a type of shrub or small tree that is native to Australia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Atriplex hastata subsp. triangularis include being an anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
